entities.title: Build a game
entities.summary: The build step of a game's pipeline: the game's tests, its Godot tests when it has them, its build, and the Worker bundled without deploying.
entities.trigger: A commit on main that changes the game's folder, vendor/, the step folders or the migration gate (the pipeline's paths; README.md), picked up by a zazzle builder.
checks: npm ci and npm test in games/GAME
npm run test:godot, when the game's package.json has it
npm run build, and no .dev folder in dist/
wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir, with the game's locked wrangler
entities.blocks: the deploy step: a failed build leaves nothing to deploy
notChecked: The .dev validators and the Database migration pull request check: pull-request checks stay in .github/workflows until zizd runs them.
LodeStar and Dawn Chorus: neither has a pipeline here.

entities.title: Deploy a game
entities.summary: The deploy step: refuses without credentials, holds back an unacknowledged database change, then uploads the build's bundle and assets.
entities.trigger: A zazzle deployer serving the pipeline, on the newest finished build of main.
checks: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and GITHUB_TOKEN are set, and the artifacts are of this game and commit
migration-gate.sh deploy for this game: every worker/schema.sql or worker/migrations/ change since the last deploy by zizd is acknowledged in its pull request
ZAZZLE_HALT_FILE before the gate and before the upload (exit 75)
notChecked: Whether the migration was in fact applied to production: the gate reads the acknowledgement, not the database.
